ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Geldwäschegesetz (GwG) of 23 Jun 2017 (BGBl. I S. 1822), as amended by the Transparency Register and Financial Information Act (TraFinG) of 12 Aug 2021 and the Act on the Design of Access to the Transparency Register of 30 Jul 2024; Transparency Register (Transparenzregister) established under § 20 GwG and operated by Bundesanzeiger GmbH under the Federal Ministry of Justice; supporting provisions in the GmbH Act (GmbHG), Commercial Code (HGB) and German Civil Code (BGB).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level_advisory_note: Full direct access is granted to German competent authorities, notaries and supervisory bodies; general public access requires a verified legitimate interest (journalistic, civil society or qualified professional) following the Federal Constitutional Court order of 2 Nov 2023 (1 BvR 1612/22).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Articles of Association (Gesellschaftsvertrag) including shareholder list and managing director appointment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: German Notary (Notar) at the district of the registered seat
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not applicable - domestic German notarial deed; no legalization or apostille required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified identity document (passport or national ID) of each direct shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport office or consulate of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the designated competent authority of the issuing state, followed by certified German translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and good standing of any corporate shareholder (if the UBO chain includes legal persons)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Hague Convention 1961 states) OR Consular Legalization (non-convention states), followed by certified German translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or notarized Power of Attorney for the German notary or incorporation agent, including UBO identification declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign shareholder's notary (for foreign origin) or the German notary (for domestic origin)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (foreign origin) or domestic German notarization (domestic origin)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, UBOs and proposed managing directors against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (including Council Regulations 269/2014 and 833/2014), UN Security Council sanctions lists, OFAC SDN list and German domestic sanctions lists; mandatory PEP identification and enhanced due diligence under §§ 1, 10, 14 and 15 GwG; risk-based AML/CFT classification of ISIC 2813 as medium-risk enhanced due to dual-use and export-controlled cryogenic pump technology; screening results recorded in the notary's compliance file and verified again at the Finanzamt tax-registration stage.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Unternehmensregister (www.unternehmensregister.de) and the electronic register search (Handelsregister) of the competent Amtsgericht (Registergericht); all name-clearance applications must be submitted electronically through a German notary pursuant to § 10 GmbHG and § 378 HGB.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All official registration documents must be drafted in German; the company name must be rendered in Latin script (§ 11 HGB). A name in a non-Latin script is rejected and must be transliterated. The name must be distinguishable from all existing entries, must not be misleading, and must contain the legal form suffix 'Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung' or 'GmbH' (§ 4 GmbHG, §§ 17 - 18 HGB).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Sparkasse, Kredit, Pfandbrief, Investment, Fonds, Kapitalanlage (prior BaFin licence under KWG required)
Versicherung, Versicherungsvermittlung, Bausparkasse (prior insurance supervisory approval required)
Rechtsanwalt, Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer, Patentanwalt, Arzt, Apotheke (protected professions - admission required or blocked)
Deutschland, Bund, Bundes-, Bundesrepublik, Amts-, Staats-, Europäische (state or sovereign imprint - ministerial authorization required)
München, Berlin, Hamburg or other geographic names when no genuine local connection exists (§ 18(2) HGB non-deception rule)
Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing trade name while the business activities and territories are not clearly distinguishable (§ 30 HGB; § 18 HGB deception ban)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.name_reservation_note: German law provides no general administrative name reservation in the Handelsregister. A preliminary name-clearance check by the notary before filing protects the name only for the pendency of the registration procedure; where urgency is proven, the Registergericht can grant a provisional injunction (einstweilige Verfügung) for a limited period, typically 30 days, after which a defined application must be filed.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registergericht rejects the name, the applicant must file a written appeal (Beschwerde) under § 58 FamFG with the competent Landgericht (Regional Court) within one month of service of the rejection, through a German lawyer or notary; a further appeal (Rechtsbeschwerde) lies to the Oberlandesgericht. Alternatively, the notary may immediately submit an amended, clearly distinctive name without reopening the incorporation file. Where rejection arises from a protected or sensitive token, obtain the controlling ministry's or regulator's approval and attach it to the re-filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.statutory_mandate_note: Section 4a GmbHG requires a registered seat (Satzungssitz) with a German street address; the registered office must be permanently reachable for formal service (Zustellung) under §§ 35, 35a GmbHG and § 8(4) GmbHG; the actual administrative seat must remain within the EEA.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole address for an ISIC 2813 manufacturing entity. A physical operational facility with a street address is mandatory for production, emissions control, occupational health and safety, customs registration and TÜV inspections of cryogenic components. A business-centre or virtual address may only supplement, never replace, the registered plant address; the Finanzamt and Gewerbeamt will deny the tax number and trade registration if the registered office is not materially connected to the business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 85% probability of an unannounced inspection within the first 12 months of operations, triggered by Gewerbeaufsichtsamt checks under §§ 21, 22 GewO, customs and export-control visits under the Außenwirtschaftsverordnung, and environmental compliance visits under the BImSchG; mandatory TÜV surveillance applies to cryogenic pressure equipment before serial production.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notary public fee for drafting and notarization of the GmbH Articles of Association, shareholder list and registration application (including statutory notification of the Transparency Register)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: German Notary (Notar) at the registered seat
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff pursuant to GNotKG (Notarkostenordnung), assessed on EUR 25,000 nominal capital; market range EUR 700 - 1,200 excluding VAT

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Register (Handelsregister) registration fee - part B entry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: GNotKG court fee table (number 2120) - Land court administration fee; range EUR 150 - 600 depending on the federal state

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Municipal trade office (Gewerbeamt / Ordnungsamt) of the registered seat
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Municipal administrative fee tariffs; typically EUR 20 - 150 (state-specific)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory IHK Chamber of Industry and Commerce - entry fee and minimum pro-rata annual contribution
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) of the registered seat
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: IHK-Gesetz § 3(3) and chamber fee statutes; entry fee plus minimum contribution not exceeding EUR 250 for the first year

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Transparency Register (Transparenzregister) notification via notary and first-year register fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Transparenzregister (Bundesanzeiger GmbH, Federal Ministry of Justice)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Verordnung über Gebühren des Transparenzregisters - EUR 6.25 electronic notification plus EUR 18.50 annual entity fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Federal Tax Office (Finanzamt) registration - tax questionnaire (Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung) and VAT-ID application
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Finanzamt (Federal Tax Office) for the registered seat

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille(s) for foreign UBO identity documents and corporate certificates (2 documents) plus certified German translations (5 pages)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Designated apostille authority of the document's country of origin; certified translator or notary in Germany
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark - apostille approx. USD 75 per document; certified German translation USD 55 - 110 per page plus notarial certification

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory minimum share capital deposit - EUR 25,000 into a notary-supervised blocked account (Sonderkonto) evidenced before registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: German licensed bank of the GmbH's choosing; released solely to the managing directors upon Handelsregister registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Mandatory capital requirement - § 5(1) and § 7(2) GmbHG; full payment required for a one-person GmbH (single-member) or 50% (EUR 12,500) in cash plus notarized declaration for a multi-member GmbH

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank escrow (blocked account - Sonderkonto) opening charge and notary fee for capital-availability confirmation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: German licensed commercial bank plus notary reimbursables
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark - EUR 30 - 80 bank account opening and confirmation of funds

stage_1.foreign_exchange_and_notes: USD figures converted at EUR/USD 1.08 for budgetary approximation only and to be adjusted at the incorporation date; EUR 27,000 of the total represents the statutory minimum share capital deposit, which is returned to the company's ordinary bank account upon Handelsregister registration and is not a treasury fee.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Gesetz betreffend die Gesellschaften mit beschränkter Haftung (GmbHG), core provisions §§ 1, 2, 3, 4a, 5, 7, 8, 10, 35-44; Handelsgesetzbuch (HGB) §§ 8-15, 106-108, 162; Gewerbeordnung (GewO) §§ 14, 55 for industrial licensing; Bundes-Immissionsschutzgesetz (BImSchG) §§ 4, 5, 22 together with the 4. BImSchV Annex 1 for facility thresholds.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Handelsregisterabteilung des Amtsgerichts (Commercial Register Division of the Local Court) at the registered seat of the GmbH; electronic filings are transmitted through the notary's secure EGVP mailbox and final publication occurs in the Bundesanzeiger / Unternehmensregister.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association (Gesellschaftsvertrag) executed by notarial deed, together with the notarized Application for Registration in the Commercial Register (Anmeldung zur Eintragung in das Handelsregister) filed under § 7 GmbHG.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum statutory share capital is €25,000 (§ 5 GmbHG). Before the registration application, each cash subscription must be paid in to at least €12,500 (one quarter of the nominal amount), deposited into a blocked escrow bank account (Sperrkonto) opened in the name of the GmbH i.G. Non-cash contributions must be fully furnished and documented. The managing directors must certify under § 8 GmbHG that the paid-in capital is at their free disposal; funds may not be released to the founders until the Commercial Register entry is completed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE MANAGING DIRECTORS OF [●] GMBH, Adopted [●]. 1. The Managing Directors ratified the notarized Articles of Association executed before Notary [●] and the subscription of the share capital by the founding shareholders. 2. The registered office is established at [● street, postal code, city]. 3. [Name] is appointed sole Managing Director with sole signatory authority under § 35 GmbHG; shareholder approval for ordinary transactions is not required. 4. The Managing Directors are instructed to file the Amtsgericht registration, open the blocked capital account, and obtain the Gewerbeanmeldung and all environmental and industrial licenses. 5. All actions of the Managing Director prior to this resolution are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Association and Appointment of Managing Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (Notar) competent for the registered seat, acting in preparation for the Registergericht (Amtsgericht) at the same district court.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founders appear personally or by power of attorney before the German notary. The notary reads, authenticates, and witnesses the Gesellschaftsvertrag or statutory Musterprotokoll, verifies identities, reviews the appointment of managing directors, and records the allocation of share subscriptions. The notarial session also covers the signature of the registration application to be submitted later. After execution, the notary retains the deed and issues certified copies to the founders for bank and authority filings.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national identity card for each founding shareholder and managing director
Draft articles of association (Gesellschaftsvertrag) or the statutory Musterprotokoll model protocol
Notarized powers of attorney (Vollmachten) for any absent founders or agents
Beneficial ownership information (wirtschaftlich Berechtigter) with names, birth data, and controlling interest particulars for the Transparenzregister
For non-EU shareholders: proof of residence or work status and, where applicable, preliminary authorization for business activity
Certified copies and a digital version of the intended deed for notarial archiving
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary objects to the content, e.g., missing contribution declarations or incorrect firm elements, amend the draft and re-execute the notarial deed or issue a notarial addendum (Nachtrag) before the subsequent filing step.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Blocked Capital Account (Sperrkonto) and Deposit of Minimum Paid-in Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: German credit institution holding the blocked account (e.g., Commerzbank, Deutsche Bank, or Sparkasse) under supervision of the Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht (BaFin).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the notarized incorporation deed, the founders open an escrow-type account in the name of 'GmbH in Gründung'. At least €12,500 per cash subscription, representing one quarter of the €25,000 minimum capital, must be irrevocably transferred. The bank is instructed to block the funds until the Commercial Register registration. The bank then issues the statutory capital confirmation letter confirming payment and free availability for the managing directors under § 8 GmbHG.
required_dossiers: Notarized copy of the Gesellschaftsvertrag / notarial deed
Confirmed shareholder list with nominal subscription amounts and amounts paid in
Managing director's valid identification document and appointment certificate
Pro-forma Anmeldung zur Eintragung for the bank's KYC and account documentation
Beneficial ownership documentation (Transparenzregister screening) for each individual controlling more than 25% of capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises KYC, sanctions, or beneficial ownership concerns, the founding team must correct the Transparenzregister declaration, provide updated due diligence documents, or engage another credit institution and restart the capital deposit procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Register Application and Judicial Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registergericht — Handelsregisterabteilung des Amtsgerichts at the district of the registered seat; electronic submission by the notary through the EGVP secure channel.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the capital deposit is verified, the notary submits the notarized Anmeldung zur Eintragung, the shareholder list, the managing directors' statutory declaration, and the bank capital confirmation to the Registergericht. The court examines the formal legality of the articles, the legal object, the officers, the capital subscription and coverage, and may issue deficiency rulings. Upon satisfaction, the court orders the registration of the GmbH in the Commercial Register, issues the HRB number, and publishes the incorporation particulars.
required_dossiers: Notarized Anmeldung zur Eintragung signed by all managing directors
Notarially authenticated Gesellschaftsvertrag or Musterprotokoll
List of shareholders (Gesellschafterliste) with subscriptions and contributions paid
Managing directors' written declaration under § 8 GmbHG confirming free disposal of the minimum capital and absence of disqualifying criminal convictions
Bank confirmation letter (Sperrkonto) evidencing payment of at least €12,500 and unrestricted availability
Where a restricted trade is involved, the relevant GewO permit or a statutory declaration that no such permit is required
Notarized special powers of attorney for the notary or agents submitting the filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the court issues an inquiry (Verfügung), the notary cures the deficiencies by amending the application or producing the omitted exhibits within the court's deadline. In case of refusal, the shareholders may file a formal complaint (Beschwerde) with the Landgericht under § 382 FamFG and request an oral hearing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Entry into the Commercial Register, Publication, and Transparenzregister Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Amtsgericht — Handelsregister for registration and official publication; the national Transparenzregister operated through the Bundesanzeiger electronic platform for beneficial ownership.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following the court's registration order, the GmbH's legal name, seat, object, share capital, managing directors, and date of articles are published. The notary obtains the final Handelsregisterauszug with the HRB number. Within one business day, the company files the complete list of beneficial owners (wirtschaftlich Berechtigte) in the Transparenzregister, including names, dates of birth, residences, and the nature and extent of economic control; the register must thereafter be kept current.
required_dossiers: Commercial Register extract (Handelsregisterauszug) with HRB number and registration date
Notarial deed and certified copy of the incorporation filing
Publication confirmation from the Bundesanzeiger / Unternehmensregister
Signed Transparenzregister declaration for each ultimate beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication contains errors, request a rectification order (Berichtigungsverfügung) from the Registergericht. If a late Transparenzregister filing triggers administrative fines, submit a protective application together with documented proof of the court's registration date to mitigate liability.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Trade Registration and Facility Premises Licensing (Gewerbeanmeldung)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gewerbeamt / Ordnungsamt of the municipality where the production facility is located, with automatic notifications to the Finanzamt, IHK, and Berufsgenossenschaft.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Gewerbeanmeldung under § 14 GewO to the Trade Office at the production site. The Trade Office issues the Gewerbeschein and forwards the data to the tax office for corporate tax and VAT registration, to the IHK for compulsory chamber membership, and to the statutory accident insurer. For cryogenic pump manufacturing, the operator must present the lease or ownership title of the facility, prepare the facility layout plan, and, where pressure equipment and solvent bays exist, obtain the occupational clearance (Betriebsstättenfreigabe) after an inspection by the Gewerbeaufsichtsamt. Fire-safety and structural inspections must be arranged in parallel before commencement of operations.
required_dossiers: Handelsregisterauszug showing the HRB number and registered corporate object
Managing director's identification and appointment certificate
Certified lease agreement or title deed for the production facility
Layout plan showing assembly lines, pressure test bays, cryogenic test pits, nitrogen purge areas, and storage zones
Certificate of non-conviction (Führungszeugnis) where required by the local Gewerbeordnung
Proof of immission control notification or permit under BImSchG where applicable
Environmental pre-consultation record and hazardous waste register excerpt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Trade Office rejects or queries the application, the operator may cure the identified deficiencies, amend the facility plans, obtain a supplemental fire-safety expert opinion, and re-file within the statutory fee schedule of €40 to €800. Refusals may be appealed to the Landratsamt or Regierungspräsidium under general public-law remedies.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Gewerbeaufsichtsamt des Landes (State Industrial Supervision and Occupational Safety Inspectorate), together with the municipal Gewerbeamt/Ordnungsamt for trade licensing, the Bezirksregierung/Regierungspräsidium for immission control permits, and the Bundesanstalt für Arbeitsschutz und Arbeitsmedizin (BAuA) for pressure equipment market surveillance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Betriebsstättenfreigabe und Gewerbezulassung (Industrial Operating Approval and Trade License) under § 14 GewO for the cryogenic pump manufacturing facility; where the annexed surface-treatment or solvent-consuming installations exceed the 4. BImSchV Annex 1 thresholds, an additional Genehmigung nach § 4 BImSchG (permit for installations requiring approval) is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Umweltbundesamt (UBA) provides federal technical guidance; the competent authority is the Landesumweltamt / Regierungspräsidium acting as the immissions control authority (Immissionsschutzbehörde) of the Land where the facility is registered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category: Anzeige/Registrierungsverfahren (registration and notification) — no full EIA (nicht UVP-pflichtig) for standard cryogenic pump assembly. A full EIA, together with a § 4 BImSchG permit, becomes mandatory only if the production line includes solvent degreasing or coating with solvent consumption ≥ 25 t/a or paint application ≥ 5,000 kg/a, triggering Annex 1 item 5.1.1 of the 4. BImSchV.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: compliance with WHG § 62 and AwSV for oil storage and hazardous-substance handling; if directly discharged, AbwV Annex 40 thresholds apply — COD ≤ 150 mg/l, hydrocarbons ≤ 10 mg/l, AOX ≤ 0.5 mg/l, pH 6.5–9.0. Air emissions: VOC from degreasing and coating shall not exceed 20 mg C/m³ at 20 °C with mass-flow limitation per the 31. BImSchV. Nitrogen purge and cryogenic storage areas must maintain oxygen monitoring at 19.5–23 vol% with alarming. Waste from machining (emulsions, sludges) must be classified per AVV, recorded in the electronic waste register (e-kwl/ZED), and disposed of by licensed waste carriers under KrWG.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety final inspection (Brandschutzabnahme) by the local fire authority, including alarm systems, evacuation routes, and extinguishing installations for solvent and cryogenic areas. Structural integrity certificate (Standsicherheitsnachweis) for the production hall covering the cryogenic test pit, crane runway, and tank foundations. Occupational clearance (Arbeitsstättenbegehung) by the Gewerbeaufsichtsamt includes registration of overthreshold pressure equipment under § 15 BetrSichV, an explosion-protection document where solvents are present, workplace noise compliance at a daily limit of 80 dB(A) per LärmVibrationsArbSchV, provision of PPE and signage for cryogenic burn hazards, and first-aid and emergency evacuation readiness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bundeszentralamt für Steuern (BZSt) and local Finanzamt; digital tax portal ELSTER (www.elster.de).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation in the Handelsregister, the GmbH must submit the 'Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung' (Tax Registration Questionnaire) to the locally competent Finanzamt via ELSTER to obtain the Steuernummer (income tax number). For EU VAT identification, a separate application for a USt-IdNr. (Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer) is made to BZSt, either through the online BZSt portal or by using the form provided on the business portal; this is mandatory for intra-Community supplies or cross-border services. Foreign entities without a German branch may appoint a fiscal agent or representative for VAT registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election is available for a GmbH under German law; the GmbH is compulsorily a taxable corporation subject to Körperschaftsteuer and Gewerbesteuer. Hybrid mismatch adjustments may arise under the German ATAD implementation (StAStG) for cross-border payments, but no general entity classification election is permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 22,000 prior-year turnover and EUR 50,000 expected current-year turnover (small business exemption). A foreign business making any taxable supply in Germany is generally required to register for VAT from the first transaction without a minimum threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or continuous transaction control is in place in Germany. Since 1 January 2025, all resident businesses have had the legal obligation to be able to receive structured e-invoices in EN 16931 (XRechnung or ZUGFeRD). Mandatory transmission of e-invoices in domestic B2B applies according to a phased schedule from 2026/2027/2028 depending on turnover; B2G e-invoicing via XRechnung is already compulsory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAT) applies to supplies of goods physically dispatched from Germany to a non-EU destination, provided the exporter holds full evidence of the export and meets the conditions of Section 6 UStG. Intra-Community supplies to other EU member states are also zero-rated if the purchaser has a valid VAT ID, the goods are transported to that member state, and the EU recapitulative statement is filed. Offshore installation or servicing of cryogenic pumps supplied as B2B services will generally fall under the place-of-supply rule (customer's place), with reverse-charge instead of German zero-rating; pure export of goods remains the core zero-rating category. Export proceeds may be repatriated by any banking route; German law does not impose a fixed statutory FX deadline, but the 180-day standard is used in export documentation and banking practice for payment evidence and customs valuation checks.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Ausfuhrbegleitdokument / ATLAS export certificate)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The German tax authorities rigorously inspect export evidence in VAT audits. If export zero-rating is claimed without sufficient documentary proof, the tax office issues a VAT assessment reclaiming the tax at 19% plus statutory interest under Section 233a AO and late-payment penalties. Incorrect or fraudulent zero-rating triggers liability for VAT on the supply and may be prosecuted as tax evasion under Section 370 AO, carrying imprisonment of up to 10 years and associated fines. For intra-Community supplies, knowingly false documentation is punishable under Section 26a UStG with imprisonment or fine, and the supplier becomes immediately liable for the full VAT.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Deutsche Bundesbank (Zentralverwaltung, Frankfurt am Main) is the central bank of the Federal Republic of Germany and the German member of the Eurosystem. Foreign-exchange regulation and trade-finance policy are administered jointly with the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action (BMWK) under the Foreign Trade and Payments Act (Außenwirtschaftsgesetz, AWG) and the Foreign Trade and Payments Ordinance (Außenwirtschaftsverordnung, AWV); the Federal Office for Economic Affairs and Export Control (BAFA) is the competent licensing and enforcement authority for export-control and dual-use matters; and the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (BaFin) supervises credit institutions, payment institutions and electronic-money institutions for prudential and AML (GwG) compliance. The Bundesbank operates the external-statistics reporting system for cross-border payments exceeding EUR 12,500 and represents Germany in the ECB Governing Council.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Germany applies a fully liberalised and unrestricted currency regime for both capital and current account transactions. There is no statutory distinction between capital-account and current-account convertibility, no central-bank approval requirement before acquiring or disposing of foreign currency, and no repatriation or profit-remittance clearance. This liberal state derives from Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (free movement of capital), the euro-area legal framework, and the permissive cardinal principle of Section 1(1) AWG/AWV pursuant to which foreign trade and payments are unrestricted unless expressly prohibited. A German GmbH may therefore remit dividends, interest, royalties, loan repayments, equity withdrawals and liquidation proceeds to any non-resident shareholder in EUR or any convertible foreign currency without exchange-control authorisation. Residual practical hurdles are limited to: (i) statistical cross-border payment reporting to the Deutsche Bundesbank under Section 67 AWV for every payment exceeding EUR 12,500 or any monthly aggregate exceeding EUR 12,500; (ii) EU/UN/OFAC sanctions and embargoes, which may freeze or prohibit payments to designated persons, jurisdictions or restricted industries (notably Russia, Belarus and Iran with respect to LNG and advanced industrial equipment); (iii) AML source-of-funds and beneficial-ownership verification on all capital injections; and (iv) the need to conclude a German Master Agreement for Foreign Exchange Transactions (DRV) or ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with the servicing bank before executing any derivative hedge. For a GmbH manufacturing LNG cryogenic pumps, no specific regulatory permission is required to hold USD or CNY accounts onshore, to invoice in foreign currency, or to convert export proceeds at freely negotiated market rates.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Germany imposes no statutory surrender obligation, no forced conversion into EUR, no mandatory repatriation timeline and no minimum conversion ratio for export proceeds. An exporter may lawfully retain export revenue in foreign-currency accounts at German or other EEA banks, net or offset cross-border receivables and payables, and deploy export proceeds for working capital, imports, debt service, dividends or reinvestment without prior Bundesbank approval. The only binding obligations are passive: (a) reporting to the Deutsche Bundesbank under Section 67 AWV for each inbound/outbound payment exceeding EUR 12,500 or where the monthly aggregate balance of cross-border payments exceeds EUR 12,500, the statistical filing ordinarily being executed by the domestic payment-service provider using the Bundesbank payment-code catalogue; (b) full documentation of the underlying export transaction (export invoice, ATLAS customs declaration, bill of lading/AWB/CMR and packing list) to support VAT, customs and AML verification; and (c) compliance with any contractual assignment or collection-account control mechanisms imposed by export-finance, forfaiting or supply-chain-finance providers, which are private covenants rather than regulatory exactions. There is likewise no exchange-rate margin obligation and no surrender window; hedging is effected through ordinary onshore banks under freedom of contract and ISDA/DRV documentation.
